description.value: Tree to Me Inn is a rustic-refined organic farm inn on a 40-acre property in the Similkameen Valley near Keremeos, offering five appointed guest suites with mountain and farm views. An on-site bistro and farm market serve organic produce, fresh-baked goods, and cooked meals through the week, making it a genuine stop rather than just a bed. The property sits a short drive from Apex Mountain Resort and is close to BC wine country, hiking, and the nearby lakes and rivers of the region.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully accessible and confirms an active organic farm inn at 1217 Hwy 3A, Keremeos, BC, matching OSM address and phone number exactly. Wi-Fi is confirmed both by the OSM tag (internet_access=wlan) and the rooms page ('our suites feature... Wi-Fi'). No mention of bike storage, laundry, tools, or any cycling-specific infrastructure anywhere on the site; the on-site bistro and market support 'nearby evening food' and 'nearby grocery' amenity claims.
concerns: Website branding uses 'Tree to Me Organics' alongside 'Tree to Me Inn'; OSM name 'Tree To Me Inn' matches the inn identity used in copyright footer and suite-booking pages, so no correction needed but the dual branding may cause search confusion.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, actively operating organic farm inn with bookable suites, an on-site bistro and market, and a confirmed web presence — clearly useful to touring cyclists passing through the Similkameen Valley.
enrichment_extras.notes: An after-hours phone number (250-499-9271) appears on the website and contact page but is not in the OSM record.

Nearby evening food.detail: On-site bistro serves dinner Tuesday through Saturday until 8pm

Nearby grocery.detail: On-site market sells organic farm produce, condiments, breads, take-away meals, soups, and locally sourced products
